gst.recovery_notice: These are bills retained on this device for the current shop and issuing account. Recovery keeps their original number and payment details. This screen does not confirm server synchronization or GST filing.
gst.recovery_empty: No queued bills are visible for this account and shop. Check the evidence below; an empty queue does not prove that every device bill reached the server.
gst.recovery_read_failed: Device evidence could not be read. Keep the app data and original bills; do not reset storage or collect payment again.
gst.recovery_export_unavailable: File export is unavailable on this device.
gst.recovery_export_notice: The export contains original bill and payment details, customer information, GST identities and device recovery records for this account and shop. Choose where to save or share it. The SHA-256 hash checks the exported content; it is not a legal signature. Records that cannot be attributed safely are excluded.
gst.recovery_unattributed: {n} unreadable or unassigned device records could not be attributed to this account. Their content is excluded from this export and remains on the device.
gst.recovery.local_evidence_unreadable: Recovery stopped because device evidence is damaged or inconsistent. The original records have been retained for review.
gst.recovery.local_evidence_conflict: Recovery found different bill content for the same client ID. Both sources remain available for review; the invoice number will not be reused.
gst.recovery.local_storage_unavailable: Recovery could not read or save device storage. Keep the original bill and retry when storage is available.
gst.recovery_issue.scopeMismatch: Account or shop mismatch; content excluded
gst.issued_bill_retained: This issued GST bill is retained. Retry keeps its original invoice number and payment details; it cannot be discarded or edited.
gst.local_save_failed: Unable to save the bill on this device. Keep the cart and retry; do not collect payment again.
gst.sync_unconfirmed: The server response could not confirm this bill. Its original number and payment details remain saved on this device. Retry synchronization; do not collect payment again.
gst.sale_request_conflict: This request conflicts with a bill already recorded on the server. Keep the original bill saved and ask the shop owner to review it in GST recovery. Do not create a replacement bill or collect payment again.
sales.discard_body: It was never recorded on the server. Stock comes back, and the cart is restored if it's empty.
sales.discard_stock_only: Stock put back. Cart already has items.
